rationale: All runs are setup-limited at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC; hold, slew/cap (0 vs bar 295) and DRC never bind. At 8.59 ns the best runs keep ~1.6 ns slack, so timing repair idles (margins irrelevant) and T_eff is the natural path set by netlist, placement and electrical repair. Round 2's recipe (orfs, util 27, AREA 3, routability, no timing-driven placement) won at 6.92. blabla used that recipe and its reg-to-reg path was 6.62 ns (only port IO delay hurt it at 17.7 ns), with slew repair 39% (+41 buffers) and density 52%; denser placement also shortened wires (40.1k->36.9k um, 7.03->6.92). Pin slew 40 and density_delta 28; TPE keeps buffering/sizing true from the two best runs.
